analysis.summary: Mr A-Game makes Zelda let's plays and challenge series, mostly Breath of the Wild randomizers, a One Hit Obliterator run and a 100% Tears of the Kingdom playthrough, plus full-movie compilations of other Nintendo games. The thumbnails never show a face: a clean cut-out of Link with a white outline over a bright game scene, and at most one short caption.
analysis.niche: Zelda Breath of the Wild randomizers, challenge runs and 100% playthroughs

styleTraits.title: Link as a sticker
styleTraits.detail: Link is cut out from the game with a thick white outline, large and close to the camera, often looking worried or surprised. The outline separates him from the busy background and keeps him readable at small size.

styleTraits.title: Captions like game notifications
styleTraits.detail: Randomizer videos use a small italic white caption with item icons, written like an in-game message: 'Lynels can now spawn everywhere', 'Hylian Shield was removed from your inventory'. It states the twist of the episode in plain words.

styleTraits.title: One big number for long series
styleTraits.detail: The 100% Tears of the Kingdom series uses one huge white '100%' with a black outline next to Link, so every episode is recognised as part of the same run.

styleTraits.title: Bright Hyrule, few words
styleTraits.detail: Backgrounds are the blue skies, green fields and lava reds of Breath of the Wild, kept bright. Many thumbnails have no text at all, like the glowing Link holding the One Hit Obliterator.

standouts.why: About 263,000 views, 5.4 times the median. Link seen from behind on a cliff over Hyrule, wrapped in the blue glow of the One Hit Obliterator, with no text. Breath of the Wild players know that weapon, so the image alone may say 'every enemy dies in one hit'.

About 239,000 views, 4.9 times the median. Link in dark armour and a white helmet with a red plume, a caption 'Lynels can now spawn everywhere' and three item icons. The caption reads like a rule change from the game, which probably made the 'version 4.0' of the randomizer feel new.

About 111,000 views, 2.3 times the median. A panicked Link over lava and the caption 'Hylian Shield was removed from your inventory'. The loss is specific and slightly funny, and Zelda fans know what losing that shield means.

lessons: Cut out your main character with a thick white outline so it stays clear over a busy background.
Write a twist as a game notification: it feels like part of the game rather than an advert.
Give a long series one fixed mark, like Mr A-Game's '100%', so each episode is recognisable.
On this channel, Zelda challenge twists pulled the most; full-movie compilations sat around 0.5 to 0.7 times the median and Splatoon Raiders episodes around 0.2 to 0.3.
analysis.experiment: For your next challenge video, test a thumbnail with a caption written like an in-game message ('Your shield was removed') against one with a classic all-caps headline.

faq.q: How many subscribers does Mr A-Game have?
faq.a: As of 26 October 2026, Mr A-Game has about 370K subscribers and about 1.8K videos. The latest 30 long uploads have a median of about 48,500 views. The biggest in that sample is 'What if we put the One Hit Obliterator in ALL of Breath of the Wild?', with about 263,000 views.

faq.q: What does Mr A-Game make videos about?
faq.a: Mostly Zelda: Breath of the Wild randomizers, challenge runs like the One Hit Obliterator series, and a 100% playthrough of Tears of the Kingdom. He also posts full-movie compilations of Nintendo games and a few Mario and Splatoon videos.

faq.q: What do Mr A-Game's thumbnails look like?
faq.a: Bright Hyrule scenes with Link cut out and outlined in white, close to the camera. Randomizer episodes add a small italic caption written like a game message; the 100% series shows a huge '100%'. There is no face cam and often no text at all.
